entities.summary: Aisha Franz is a German illustrator and comic book artist based in Berlin. She is known for her internationally published graphic novels and zines. Aisha Franz was a painters & sculptors from Fürth (b. 1984, Fürth). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
